title: Purple Hammer Warrior
description: A female warrior with short dark hair stands in a dynamic combat pose against a solid gray background. She wears a white and purple cropped top with matching pants, purple gauntlets and boots, and wields a massive purple warhammer with glowing crackling patterns on its head.
prompt: A fierce young woman with short dark purple hair in a dynamic action stance, wearing a white and purple cropped top with intricate patterns, white pants with purple accents, purple gauntlets and armored boots. She holds a large purple warhammer with glowing crackle details in both hands, ready to strike. Solid gray background, clean comic book style with bold outlines and vibrant colors.
